cited.quote: A target of Rs.10 crore has been fixed for education loans for the Financial Year

rationale: C2 shows only a small cooperative education-loan target for economically disadvantaged students; C3 covers a limited loan scheme for BC/MBC students. Neither is a collateral-free loan up to 20 lakh for all students from undergraduate to PhD. C4/C5 concern crop loan waiver. Related activity only.

cited.quote: milch cows will be provided at no cost to 10,000 eligible beneficiaries at a cost of Rs.56.75 crore

rationale: C5 is a policy note plan (will be provided) for 10,000 women beneficiaries with cows and 30,000 for goats, far from two lakh families, and no GO or launch is shown. Other extracts concern dairy support unrelated to free distribution.

cited.quote: After the Union Government completes the caste enumeration, the Government of Tamil Nadu will conduct the Social Justice Survey.

rationale: C2 and C3 state the survey will be conducted only after the Union completes caste enumeration; this is a statement of intent, not an official step. C1 concerns other surveys.

No extract concerns a separate 'Contribution Budget' classification in the budget presentation. C3 concerns economic-cum-purpose classification for GSDP estimation, and the CAG extracts concern IFHRMS accounts compilation; none is about the commitment.

cited.quote: 25% subsidy on the value of eligible plant and machinery, maximum Rs.150 lakh

rationale: C2 and C3 describe existing capital subsidy schemes (including NEEDS), not a new subsidy of up to 50 lakh for adopting new technologies; no new GO or launch is shown after the government took office. Related activity only.

cited.quote: 116 market improvement works have been taken up under various schemes
It is proposed to develop new markets and modernize existing markets by undertaking further new projects during 2026–27.

rationale: C1 reports market works in town panchayats only, undated, and C2 says new market projects are merely proposed for urban bodies. C4/C5 only list rural haats as permitted works in a Union-law scheme. No dedicated step for markets in every village.

cited.quote: has been implementing the School Innovation Development Project since the academic year 2022-23

rationale: C2 shows an existing school innovation and entrepreneurship project running since 2022-23 for classes 6 to 12 in government schools, predating this government. No new entrepreneurship classes in all schools are shown.

cited.quote: an allocation of Rs.2 crore to upgrade the infrastructure of the Tamil Nadu Physical Education and Sports University

rationale: C1 and C2 describe an already existing sports university. C3, a budget speech, only allocates Rs.2 crore for infrastructure upgrade and announces Olympic Centres of Excellence that will be established. No new university or enabling GO is shown.

cited.quote: this Government will undertake all necessary efforts to move education from the Concurrent List to the State List

rationale: C4, the Governor's address, states intent only. No GO, resolution, committee or other dedicated measure to shift education to the State List appears in the extracts.

cited.quote: The Government continues to urge the Central Government to facilitate the reconvening of the JWG

rationale: C3 concerns fisheries talks, not ethnic discrimination. C1 mentions a letter to the Prime Minister dated before the government took office, and it is about citizenship for refugees. No formal step urging the Union on ethnic discrimination in Sri Lanka is shown.

cited.quote: addressed a letter to the Hon'ble Prime Minister of India on February 15, 2026

rationale: C2's letter is dated 2026-02-15, before the government took office, and concerns citizenship for refugee Sri Lankan Tamils in India, not minority rights in Sri Lanka. Other extracts are on culture and minorities welfare in the State.

rationale: C1 reports that after the formation of this Government 3,299 free house site pattas were issued by regularising long-standing residential encroachments on unobjectionable Government poramboke lands, matching the promise. The note is undated and gives no GO date, so no realisation date can be taken.

rationale: C1 speaks of a state procurement scheme at MSP to be notified later; it is neither a formal step urging the Union to introduce an MSP for raw coconut nor a resolution or letter. Other extracts are unrelated.

cited.quote: The existing loads in the overloaded feeders will be bifurcated to ensure reliable and uninterrupted power supply

rationale: C3 only states a future plan to bifurcate loads on overloaded feeders; no GO, tender or sanction for the 10 thousand feeders or any generation addition is shown. C2 gives general capacity data.

rationale: C2, the Governor's address, states intent (will be recreated) for Adichanallur, Kodumanal and Gangaikonda Cholapuram. C3 to C5 show only general VR use and virtual tours online. No GO, tender or launch is shown.
